resources.string: Each key runs its own actions
Press for one step, hold to keep changing

A key with a hold or double-press action, or any key while Both keys is set, acts on a single press only when you release it, or once the double-press window has passed. Without them the press acts at once, which suits the shutter. As a pair, a press moves one step and holding the key keeps changing the value: up zooms in, raises EV and ISO, lengthens the shutter and focuses farther. Invert direction swaps the keys.
